title: Sable and the Inventory
author: Xanthe Almeida
blurb: Cyrus Thackeray, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
